# =============================================================================
# local-fast worker configuration  (Phase 2)
#
# Single source of truth for the Local Fast Worker. Start/stop/check scripts and
# the benchmark harness read this file, so paths and runtime parameters are NOT
# duplicated across scripts (Phase 2 requirement §7).
#
# Parser note: the project uses a deliberately tiny stdlib YAML-subset loader
# (scripts/lf_config.py) so the service has no PyYAML dependency. Keep this file
# to scalars, simple lists and simple nested maps - no anchors, no multi-line
# strings, no inline maps.
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# STATUS: quant / context / sampling values are the PROVISIONAL Phase 2 defaults.
# The quant choice (Q4_K_M vs Q5_K_M) and the sampling presets are confirmed or
# revised at the end of Phase 2 against benchmarks/local-fast-results.md.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# =============================================================================
model: local-fast

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- model source
# Logical alias -> concrete artefact. Upper layers must only ever use `local-fast`.
source:
  logical_name: local-fast
  upstream_repo: Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B
  upstream_revision: 851bf6e806efd8d0a36b00ddf55e13ccb7b8cd0a
  gguf_repo: unsloth/Qwen3.5-4B-GGUF
  gguf_revision: e87f176479d0855a907a41277aca2f8ee7a09523
  license: apache-2.0
  parameters: 4B
  architecture: qwen3_5
  family: qwen3.5
  modalities: text
  note: upstream is a VLM; mmproj is intentionally not deployed for this text-only worker

# Selected quantisation. Q4_K_M is the Phase 2 default; see results doc.
quant: Q4_K_M
model_path: D:\MultiAgent\models\llm\Qwen3.5-4B-Q4_K_M.gguf
model_sha256: 00fe7986ff5f6b463e62455821146049db6f9313603938a70800d1fb69ef11a4
model_size_mb: 2614

# Alternatives kept on disk for A/B comparison (not deployed by default).
alternates:
  Q5_K_M: D:\MultiAgent\models\llm\Qwen3.5-4B-Q5_K_M.gguf
  Q6_K: D:\MultiAgent\models\llm\Qwen3.5-4B-Q6_K.gguf

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- runtime
runtime:
  host: 127.0.0.1
  port: 8111
  context: 8192
  # Server slots. llama-server defaults to 4 slots, which splits the usable context
  # per request: with -c 8192 and 4 slots each call only gets 2048 tokens, too small
  # for the 4K/8K summary and handoff tasks. Single-user worker, so 1 slot gives the
  # full 8192-token window per call.
  # VERIFIED: with 4 slots the GPU reported context = 457 MiB and kv_unified = true;
  # with 1 slot it reports 306 MiB and kv_unified = false. 306 MiB is exactly what the
  # metadata-derived model predicts (50 MiB + 8192 x 32768 B/token), so the default
  # multi-slot pool was overallocating context memory by ~1.56x. See
  # benchmarks/local-fast/quant-analysis.md.
  parallel: 1
  threads: 12
  threads_batch: 12
  gpu_layers: 99
  batch_size: 2048
  ubatch_size: 512
  flash_attn: auto
  cache_type_k: f16
  cache_type_v: f16
  no_mmap: false
  # Qwen3.5 defaults to thinking mode; the fast worker must not think.
  enable_thinking: false
  # Optional bearer-token auth. Leave empty for now (loopback-only service).
  # To enable, set this to the NAME of an environment variable holding the key,
  # e.g. local_fast_api_key, and export it before starting the service.
  api_key_env: ""
  # VRAM safety: refuse to start if free VRAM is below this (MiB).
  min_free_vram_mb: 4096
  # expected steady-state footprint, used by check script
  expected_vram_mb: 3200

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- paths
paths:
  llama_dir: D:\MultiAgent\tools\llama.cpp\b11254-cuda13.4
  server_exe: D:\MultiAgent\tools\llama.cpp\b11254-cuda13.4\llama-server.exe
  logs_dir: D:\MultiAgent\logs
  pid_file: D:\MultiAgent\logs\local-fast.pid
  stdout_log: D:\MultiAgent\logs\local-fast.stdout.log
  stderr_log: D:\MultiAgent\logs\local-fast.stderr.log
  health_url: http://127.0.0.1:8111/health
  models_url: http://127.0.0.1:8111/v1/models

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- sampling presets
# `deterministic` is for JSON / routing / extraction / validation.
# `general` is for summaries, simple code and handoff writing.
presets:
  deterministic:
    temperature: 0.0
    top_p: 1.0
    top_k: 20
    min_p: 0.0
    repeat_penalty: 1.05
    seed: 20260401
    enable_thinking: false
  general:
    temperature: 0.3
    top_p: 0.9
    top_k: 40
    min_p: 0.05
    repeat_penalty: 1.05
    seed: 20260401
    enable_thinking: false

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- service limits
limits:
  request_timeout_s: 300
  max_tokens_default: 512
  max_tokens_max: 2048
  idle_unload_s: 0

  # retrieval
  try {
    $body = @{ project = $Project; query = 'what port does the fast worker use'; top_k = 3 } | ConvertTo-Json
    $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "$base/v1/retrieve" -Method Post -Body $body -ContentType 'application/json' -TimeoutSec 120
    Write-Host "retrieve : $($r.results.Count) results in $($r.seconds)s"
    if ($r.results.Count -eq 0) { $warnings += "retrieve returned no results" }
    else {
      $top = $r.results[0]
      Write-Host "           top: $($top.source_path):$($top.start_line) score=$([math]::Round($top.score,4))" -ForegroundColor Green
    }
  } catch { Write-Host "retrieve : FAILED $($_.Exception.Message)" -ForegroundColor Red; $problems += "retrieve call failed" }
}

$listeners = Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort $Port -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
if ($listeners) {
  $addrs = @($listeners | ForEach-Object { $_.LocalAddress } | Sort-Object -Unique)
  $nonLoop = @($addrs | Where-Object { $_ -notin @('127.0.0.1', '::1') })
  Write-Host "bind     : $($addrs -join ', ')"
  if ($nonLoop.Count) { Write-Host "bind     : EXPOSED on $($nonLoop -join ', ')" -ForegroundColor Red; $problems += "non-loopback bind" }
  else { Write-Host "bind     : OK loopback only" -ForegroundColor Green }
} else { $problems += "no listener on port $Port" }

Write-Host ""
if (-not $problems.Count -and -not $warnings.Count) { Write-Host "RESULT: HEALTHY" -ForegroundColor Green; exit 0 }
if (-not $problems.Count) {
  Write-Host "RESULT: DEGRADED" -ForegroundColor Yellow
  $warnings | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  - $_" -ForegroundColor Yellow }
  exit 1
}
Write-Host "RESULT: UNHEALTHY" -ForegroundColor Red
$problems | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  ! $_" -ForegroundColor Red }
$warnings | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  - $_" -ForegroundColor Yellow }
exit 1

<#
.SYNOPSIS
  stop-local-fast.ps1 - stop the local-fast worker cleanly.

.DESCRIPTION
  Reads the PID file and terminates the server, then waits for the port to be
  released and reports the resulting VRAM state. Safe to run when nothing is
  running (reports and exits 0).

.EXAMPLE
  powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\stop-local-fast.ps1
#>
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
  [string]$Config = 'D:\MultiAgent\config\local-fast.yaml',
  [int]$TimeoutSeconds = 30
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$ScriptDir = Split-Path -Parent $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path
$PyCfg     = Join-Path $ScriptDir 'lf_config.py'
$Py        = if (Test-Path 'D:\MultiAgent\services\llm\venv\Scripts\python.exe') { 'D:\MultiAgent\services\llm\venv\Scripts\python.exe' } else { 'D:\Python\python.exe' }

function Cfg([string]$key, $default = $null) {
  $out = & $Py $PyCfg $key --config $Config 2>$null
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($out)) { return $default }
  return ($out | Select-Object -First 1).ToString().Trim()
}
function Write-Step($m) { Write-Host "[stop-local-fast] $m" }

$PidFile = Cfg 'paths.pid_file'
$Port    = [int](Cfg 'runtime.port' 8111)

$target = $null
if (Test-Path $PidFile) {
  $raw = (Get-Content $PidFile -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
  if ($raw) {
    $raw = $raw.Trim()
    # The pid file can be truncated or corrupted (crash mid-write, manual edit).
    # Validate it is a positive integer BEFORE handing it to Get-Process, which
    # throws a parameter-binding error on non-numeric input. That error is not
    # catchable via $ErrorActionPreference and would abort the script with a
    # stack trace instead of a clean "nothing to stop".
    $parsedPid = 0
    if ([int]::TryParse($raw, [ref]$parsedPid) -and $parsedPid -gt 0) {
      $target = $parsedPid
    } else {
      Write-Step "pid file contains a non-numeric value ('$raw'); ignoring it"
    }
  }
}

# fall back to whatever owns the port, in case the pid file was lost
if (-not $target -or -not (Get-Process -Id $target -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
  $owner = Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort $Port -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
           Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty OwningProcess
  if ($owner) {
    $target = $owner
    Write-Step "pid file stale/absent; found listener on port $Port (pid $target)"
  }
}

if (-not $target) {
  Write-Step "not running (no pid file, nothing listening on $Port)"
  Remove-Item $PidFile -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  exit 0
}

$proc = if ($target) { Get-Process -Id $target -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } else { $null }
if (-not $proc) {
  if ($target) { Write-Step "pid $target no longer exists" }
  Remove-Item $PidFile -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  exit 0
}

Write-Step "stopping pid $target ($($proc.ProcessName))"
Stop-Process -Id $target -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

for ($i = 0; $i -lt $TimeoutSeconds; $i++) {
  Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
  if (-not (Get-Process -Id $target -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { break }
}
$still = Get-Process -Id $target -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
if ($still) { Write-Step "WARNING: pid $target still alive after ${TimeoutSeconds}s" }
else        { Write-Step "process exited after ~$i s" }

Remove-Item $PidFile -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

# confirm the port is free again
for ($i = 0; $i -lt 10; $i++) {
  $busy = Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort $Port -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  if (-not $busy) { break }
  Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500
}
if (Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort $Port -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
  Write-Step "WARNING: port $Port still listening"
  exit 7
}
Write-Step "port $Port released"

try {
  $v = & nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used,memory.free --format=csv,noheader
  Write-Step "vram        : $v"
} catch { }
Write-Step "STOPPED"
exit 0
